original_test_intent: Validate the eight unsuffixed GB GPU power sensors through complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence against the approved platform power specification.
original_method: The GB platform owner expands GPU1 through GPU8, maps the one-based labels to stable physical GPU identities, defines each sensor's producer and electrical boundary, and passive automation compares complete evidence under a recorded operating state.
manual_activity: The platform and power owners define the GB domain, map each one-based sensor to a stable GPU and electrical boundary, approve state-qualified ranges, then review the eight-channel result.
required_inputs: Exact PWR_GB_GPU1 through PWR_GB_GPU8 names and fitted population
Meaning of GB and per-index board/slot/module, serial, UUID and PCI BDF mapping
Authoritative producer and electrical boundary for each unsuffixed sensor
Distinction from the adjacent PWR_GB_GPU1 through GPU8_M family
Units, scale, polarity, resolution, averaging/integration window, refresh, stale and not-present semantics
Expected limits by platform power mode, GPU state, approved workload state, cooling mode and ambient temperature
Permitted correlation to driver or accelerator telemetry with boundary and timing tolerance
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target firmware/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent GPU, power, cooling and BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Enumerate eight exact names; do not send the endpoint-range string as a sensor identity
Bind one-based labels to stable physical identifiers instead of assuming discovery order
Do not count the M-suffix family or the zero-based UBB family as coverage for unsuffixed GB sensors
Compare only boundary-equivalent, time-aligned readings under an approved operating state
Do not induce workload, reload a driver, reset a GPU, command power, alter thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/implausible reading, identity drift, GPU fault, thermal/power anomaly or incomplete evidence
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, exact eight-name population and one-based identity map
Verify GB meaning, sensor producer, electrical boundary, units, timing and approved state envelope
Collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, eight exact results and BMC Web
Collect passive GPU inventory, health and power-state context without substituting another telemetry family
Perform no workload, driver/GPU reset, power/threshold/BMC/log mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define GB and approve GPU1-GPU8 population plus stable physical/software map
Define unsuffixed sensor producer and measurement boundary distinct from M channels
Approve state-qualified power limits, timing semantics and any cross-source tolerance
Review all eight results and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GB DOMAIN DEFINITION, ONE-BASED GPU MAP AND BOUNDARY-SPECIFIC POWER ENVELOPE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a GB GPU1-GPU8 identity table including exact sensor, board/slot, module serial, UUID/BDF, producer and electrical boundary, then evaluate complete synchronized evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces a broad substring filter with individually accountable channels and a boundary-aware comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Related UBB, M-suffix or driver telemetry may aid diagnosis but cannot satisfy this exact unsuffixed GB family.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One-based BMC labels can be mistakenly aligned to zero-based software indices, shifting every reading to the wrong accelerator even when all eight values look plausible.

project_override_considerations: If GB naming represents a board or power domain rather than a physical GPU number, the owner must provide that topology explicitly. Unpopulated positions need defined not-present behavior.
expected_evidence: Approved GB meaning, exact eight-name population and one-based GPU identity map
Per-channel sensor producer/electrical boundary, units, timing and state-qualified limits
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact sensor results
BMC Web and passive GPU inventory/health/power-state context with same-target proof
Explicit distinction from UBB and M-suffix families
No-workload/no-driver-reset/no-GPU-reset/no-power/no-threshold/no-BMC-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently identify the unsuffixed PWR_GB_GPU family; endpoint notation still requires exact expansion but is not a competing target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive review is identifiable after the owner defines GB topology, one-based mapping, measurement boundary and state-qualified criteria.

review_improvement: Prevents an off-by-one GPU association and explicitly separates unsuffixed GB power from both zero-based UBB and M-suffix telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: A complete set of eight plausible wattage values can still be assigned to the wrong GPUs when one-based BMC labels are joined to zero-based software enumeration. Acceptance therefore requires stable slot/module identity and cannot rely on list order or numeric label arithmetic.
